title: Running time of the zero-prefixing machine
statement: For every fixed binary word $w$, the machine with no work tapes computes, on every binary input $x$, the word formed by $|x|$ zero bits followed by $w$ in exactly $(|w|+2)(|x|+1)$ steps.
replaced: For every fixed word $w$, the zero-prefixing emitter computes, on each input $x$, the word of $|x|$ zero bits followed by $w$; its running time is at most the monotone linear budget $(|w|+2)(n+1)$ on inputs of length $n$.
